newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Federal votes split, div hike.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Federal votes split, div hike.

text.p: Commercial Federal Corp said its board authorized a three-for-two stock split in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend and an increase of five percent in the cash dividend payment.
The new cash dividend rate of $0.07 per share will apply to the new shares issued as a result of the stock dividend.
The stock and cash dividend will be payable January 14, 1997 to holders of record as of December 31, 1996.
Commercial Federal is the parent company of Commercial Federal Bank.

At the company's annual meeting, chairman William Fitzgerald said recent actions -- its repurchase of 1.3 million shares of common stock and the enactment of legislation to recapitalize the Savings Association Insurance Fund -- should significantly enhance future stockholder value.
